Pull request #3392 in re-cinq/lore: Spec tickets joins the Loops tab: a switch, and its runs on the board

Author: gedaiu
Opened: 2026-10-24T00:22:44Z
Closed: 2026-10-24T00:30:30Z
Merged: 2026-10-24T00:30:30Z
Link: https://github.com/re-cinq/lore/pull/3392

## Why

The `spec-tickets` line files story and task issues for every spec that merges, on every onboarded repository, with no way to turn it off and nothing on the Loops tab to show a run that failed. Every other loop that writes to GitHub on its own has a switch and board rows there; this one, which feeds the implementation loop its tickets, did not.

## Alternatives Considered

- Rows per issue filed rather than per spec: the run's issues live in GitHub under a filing key, and reading them back per row would cost one search per spec on every board load. The run page already lists what the `issues` station filed.
- Off by omission: rejected, it would silently stop ticketing on every repository at deploy.

## ADRs & Architecture

N/A: the seventh entry of the loop registry, in the shape of the sixth.

## Testing

- New tests: the switch (`loop-enabled.test.ts`), the starter's gate (`floor-spec-tickets.test.ts`), the key parser, the route and the queues (`routes/spec-tickets/*.test.ts`), the board row and the paused notice (`board.test.ts`); the loops route tests list the seventh loop.
